TREND INTEGRITY GATE

Profitability is not enough.

HEALTHY / REPAIRING

Can qualify when fundamentals are strong and price structure is stabilizing or improving.

QUALITY TRAP — QUARANTINE

Profitable chronic underperformer with business deterioration. Must prove both business and chart repair.

STRUCTURAL DOWNTREND — REJECT

Persistent lower highs/lows, falling averages, severe drawdown and weak relative strength. No LEAP until repair.

Two-lane qualification

A
Deep Discount / Recovery

Usually 30–70% below a meaningful high with fundamentals intact.

B
Quality Compounder Pullback

Elite profitable compounders can qualify on a smaller pullback when valuation and support create attractive long-term risk/reward.

Tariff rule

Tariffs are context only—not a qualification filter and not a scoring penalty.
